What Is MultiTwitch?

MultiTwitch (multitwitch.tv) is a well-known site for watching several Twitch streams side by side in one browser window. It solves a real problem: following multiple creators or POVs without a wall of separate tabs.

TooManyStreams: An Independent MultiTwitch Alternative

TooManyStreams is not affiliated with MultiTwitch. It is a separate, free project built for people who want the same core idea, watching multiple streams at once, with more control over layout, platforms, and audio.

Twitch and YouTube in the Same Stream Wall

Unlike a Twitch-only multi-stream setup, TooManyStreams lets you mix Twitch and YouTube channels in the same view. That matters for events where creators stream on different platforms but you still want everything in one place.

Drag, Drop, and Resize Your Layout

TooManyStreams lets you rearrange your stream wall with drag and drop instead of a fixed grid. Resize, reorder, and rebuild your layout as an event changes, so your view always matches what is happening.

Save and Share Your Stream Wall

Build a layout once and come back to it, or share it with someone else so they see the same streams in the same arrangement. That is useful for recurring watch parties or recommending a setup to friends.

Choose Which Stream Has Audio

With several streams playing at once, TooManyStreams lets you pick one main stream for audio while the rest stay visible, so you always know what is happening even when your attention is on a single feed.

Try a Free MultiTwitch Alternative

If you are searching for a MultiTwitch alternative that also handles YouTube and gives you more layout control, TooManyStreams is free to try with no installation or account required.
